_comment: Single source of plain text for Intelligence checks (English and Swahili); tested by tests/test_intel_plain.py.

title.en: Cash and sales

lead.sw: Pesa zinazoingia na kutoka kwenye kaunta na akaunti za malipo, na hali ya mauzo na keshia.

title.en: Stock
title.sw: Bidhaa (hisa)

lead.en: Products running out, going missing, expiring or sitting unsold.
lead.sw: Bidhaa zinazoisha, zinazopotea, zinazoisha muda au zinazokaa bila kuuzwa.

title.en: Customers
title.sw: Wateja

lead.en: Customers who owe you, pay late or have too much credit.
lead.sw: Wateja wanaokudai, wanaochelewa kulipa au wenye mkopo mkubwa mno.

title.en: Suppliers
title.sw: Wasambazaji

lead.en: Supplier invoices, payments, prices and orders.
lead.sw: Ankara za wasambazaji, malipo, bei na oda.

title.en: Staff
title.sw: Wafanyakazi

lead.en: Wages, leave, overtime, and who did what in Ziira.
lead.sw: Mishahara, likizo, saa za ziada, na nani alifanya nini kwenye Ziira.

title.en: Your books
title.sw: Hesabu za biashara

lead.sw: Rekodi za hesabu, matumizi, miezi iliyofungwa, kulinganisha na benki na faida.

high_percent.sw: Kuvuka kikomo cha mkopo kwa asilimia ngapi ndipo iwe ya haraka

min_override.sw: Punguzo dogo kabisa la bei linalostahili kuonyeshwa

min_quantity.en: Smallest number of units worth flagging

min_sales.en: Fewest sales needed before a cashier is judged

min_void.sw: Mauzo madogo kabisa yaliyofutwa yanayostahili kuonyeshwa

round_unit.en: What counts as a round figure (for example a multiple of 1,000)
round_unit.sw: Nini kinahesabiwa namba ya pande zote (mfano mara 1,000)

serious_days.sw: Siku baada ya tarehe ya kulipa ambapo inakuwa ya haraka

urgent_days.en: Days left at which it becomes urgent
urgent_days.sw: Siku zilizobaki ambapo inakuwa ya haraka

usage_pct.en: Share of colleagues with attendance records (in %) before it is flagged
usage_pct.sw: Asilimia ya wenzake wenye rekodi za kuhudhuria kabla ya kuonyeshwa

value_limit.en: Value above which it is flagged

variance_limit.en: Difference in money above which it is flagged

waiting_days.en: Days waiting before it is flagged
waiting_days.sw: Siku za kusubiri kabla ya kuonyeshwa

window_days.en: How many days of history to compare
window_days.sw: Siku ngapi za historia za kulinganisha

window_minutes.en: How many minutes apart still counts as the same event
window_minutes.sw: Dakika ngapi kati yake zinazohesabiwa kuwa tukio lilelile

within_days.sw: Siku ngapi kati yake zinazohesabiwa kuwa karibu
